L6-031 q3: 'Full days' vs 'counting from the arrival date' conflict: date arithmetic (21 to 25 Oct) gives 4 days (Long), but 18:40 arrival means only 3 completed 24 h periods on 25 Oct (Several); the time of day on 'today' is not given.
L6-042 q4: Old tenancy ends 30 Nov, new starts 1 Dec: consecutive days with no overlap is not covered by the levels. 'Tight' says same-day move, 'Gap' says a night with no home; whether there is a homeless night depends on unstated move-out/key times.
